controls.control_objective: Maintain required recovery coverage using eligible and operationally available collateral.
controls.cure_period: one business day by cash repayment or eligible collateral top-up
controls.exit_criteria: Coverage is restored to at least 1.25x and independently reconciled

controls.control_objective: Preserve ownership, priority, enforceability, and lender control.
controls.cure_period: no draw availability during any deficiency
controls.exit_criteria: Ownership, first priority, enforceability, and lender control are all verified

controls.control_objective: Keep the collateral-to-bank repayment route tested and within the approved time.
controls.cure_period: availability suspended until a successful test
controls.exit_criteria: A complete route test finishes within four hours with reconciled proceeds

controls.control_objective: Maintain borrowing-entity liquidity available for primary repayment.
controls.cure_period: five business days to deliver a remediation plan; availability remains frozen
controls.exit_criteria: Unrestricted cash is at least $25 million or a documented waiver is approved

controls.control_objective: Detect deterioration against the approved operating cash forecast and use of proceeds.
controls.cure_period: five business days to provide an updated forecast and action plan
controls.exit_criteria: Rating and repayment analysis are refreshed and the decision owner accepts the remediation plan
controls.response_sla: next scheduled review; immediate if runway is affected
controls.threshold: no >20% adverse variance to approved forecast

controls.control_objective: Prevent unapproved secured debt or liens from weakening repayment or priority.
controls.cure_period: none unless expressly waived in writing
controls.exit_criteria: The lien is released or subordinated, or an authorized written waiver is effective
controls.metric: Additional secured debt or lien creation

controls.control_objective: Keep the facility within single-name and shared-risk concentration capacity.
controls.cure_period: no draw may create or increase a breach
controls.exit_criteria: Pro forma concentration headroom is non-negative after the approved draw amount

controls.control_objective: Ensure complete and timely financial, collateral, and covenant reporting.
controls.exit_criteria: The reporting package is complete, reconciled, and accepted by credit administration
controls.response_sla: within five business days after notice
controls.threshold: within 15 business days after month end

method_limit: Illustrative control architecture only. Mappings describe intended governance coverage; they do not evidence completed conditions, active monitoring, executed covenants, observed breaches, or Coinbase policy.
